english.title: Manufacturer fail to provide info necessary to demonstrate category F1/F2/F3 firework was in conformity with Part 2
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) was the manufacturer of a category

(A)_[F1]_
(B)_[F2]_
(C)_[F3]_

firework and further to a reasoned request from an enforcing authority, namely **(..SPECIFY ENFORCING AUTHORITY..), and within such period as specified, namely **(..SPECIFY PERIOD..), failed to provide the authority with the information and documentation necessary to demonstrate that the firework was in conformity with Part 2 of the Pyrotechnic Articles (Safety) Regulations 2015 in paper or electronic form and in a language which could be easily understood by the enforcing authority
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 23(1), 62(1)(l) and 63(1)(a) of the Pyrotechnic Articles (Safety) Regulations 2015.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being a manufacturer of a cat F1/F2/F3 firework
further to reasoned request from an enforcing authority
and within such period as specified
failed to provide the authority with information / documentation necessary
to demonstrate the pyrotechnic article was in conformity with Part 2

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) Where this offence is committed in respect of a pyrotechnic article to which regulation 63(1) does not apply (i.e. not a category F1, F2 or F3 firework), it is triable either way - see offence document H12288 (CJS code PA15051)
